source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 36 in 31 cu ft French Door Refrigerator (W11819775B)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating. For live voltage checks, verify controls are off, use proper PPE, and disconnect power after measurements.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in Service Diagnostics
steps.body: Service Diagnostics active. Use ▲/▼ to reach the test number for this procedure; Freezer to enter.

steps.title: Navigate to Service Test 10
steps.body: In Service Diagnostic Mode use ▲/▼ to reach step 10. Press Freezer button to enter test. Amber step number; result on display.

steps.title: Relative humidity reading
steps.body: Displays RH percentage. Er indicates sensor fault.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Displays RH percentage. Er indicates sensor fault.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: RH sensor Er — check CN13-8 +5V and CN13-7 RT signal.

steps.title: Check RH sensor voltage
steps.body: CN13-8 +5V to CN13-6 GND = 5 VDC. Sensor pin 1 white to pin 2 black = 5 VDC.
steps.sourceExcerpt: CN13-8 +5V to CN13-6 GND = 5 VDC. Sensor pin 1 white to pin 2 black = 5 VDC.

steps.title: RH sensor verified
steps.oemOutcome: Humidity sensor reads within range or voltage path confirmed.
